---
title: "About"
---

The **Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Collaborative** convenes researchers
working on political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes. Our first conference will be held at
Harvard University in Cambridge, MA before APSA 2026.

## Organizers

The conference is organized by **[Sam Fuller](https://samjfuller.com/)**, **[Gal Bitton](https://galbitton5.github.io/)**, and **[Jack T. Rametta](https://jackrametta.com/)**.

## Sponsors 

The conference is supported by [Center for American Political Studies (CAPS)](https://caps.gov.harvard.edu/) and the [Weatherhead Center](https://www.wcfia.harvard.edu/) at Harvard University. 

## Questions, comments, concerns

Have a question, or want to share information or feedback? Please reach out to the
organizers.
